description: This file defines the SignalMasker class for RAII-based signal masking management and a function to change signal handlers. It is part of the cuttlefish namespace and provides utilities for signal handling in C++.

classes.name: SignalMasker
classes.description: A RAII class that blocks specified signals upon construction and restores previous signal mask upon destruction.

methods.name: SignalMasker
methods.description: Constructor that blocks the provided signals until the object is destroyed.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Deleted copy and move assignment operators to prevent copying or moving instances.

methods.name: ~SignalMasker
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous signal mask.

methods.name: ChangeSignalHandlers
methods.description: Function to set a custom signal handler for a list of signals.
